components.css: .ds-composer{max-width:844px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0.25rem;color:var(--foreground);font-family:var(--font-sans);}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:var(--signal);}.ds-reply{display:block;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;resize:none;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--foreground);font:13px/1.6 var(--font-sans);padding:12px 14px 6px;max-height:160px;caret-color:var(--signal);}.ds-reply:focus-visible{outline:none;}.ds-reply::placeholder{color:var(--muted);}.ds-reply:disabled{opacity:0.65;cursor:not-allowed;}.ds-attachments{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:0;padding:10px 12px 0;}.ds-attachment{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;max-width:100%;background:var(--raised);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:0.25rem;padding:5px 8px;font-size:11px;}.ds-attachment button{display:grid;place-items:center;padding:3px;background:transparent;border:0;color:var(--muted);}.ds-composer-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:4px 8px 8px;}.ds-composer-actions button{display:grid;place-items:center;width:30px;height:30px;border:0;border-radius:0.25rem;cursor:pointer;}.ds-attach{background:transparent;color:var(--muted);}.ds-attach:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--raised);color:var(--foreground);}.ds-send{margin-left:auto;background:var(--signal);color:var(--background);}.ds-send:hover:not(:disabled){opacity:0.85;}.ds-agent{font-size:11px;}.ds-agent span{color:var(--muted);}.ds-composer button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--signal);outline-offset:1px;}.ds-composer button:disabled{opacity:0.45;cursor:not-allowed;}

narrative.overview: Repomon keeps agent work in a dense, quiet desktop workspace. Home and Settings prioritize operating the fleet; Conversation gives assistant prose a continuous reading track, contains human turns on the right, and collects work behind one disclosure per turn. Wide panes earn repository context while reading widths stay bounded. The incumbent chrome, repo-leading strips, and transcript ledger remain authoritative.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic theme colors and existing SVG controls.
Compact operational rows with explicit state words.
Assistant-led prose, grouped work, and a unified attachment composer.
Useful wide context with compact pane fallbacks.

rules.name: The Zero Urgency Rule
rules.body: When a synced fleet has lanes and none needs attention, show the quiet summary and retain the recessed separator. Do not manufacture an urgent row.

rules.name: The Identity Rule
rules.body: Home leads with the repository, then the accepted headline or branch fallback. Repeated repository/title pairs retain the lane identifier.

rules.name: The Context Width Rule
rules.body: Spend wide pane space on compact lane columns and repository context while retaining a bounded transcript and composer.

dos: Do reuse the existing CSS custom properties, control components, and SVG icon library.
Do keep state words visible alongside color and preserve focus, selected, and disabled states.
Do retain the existing app tabs and mounted Terminal/Chat session when changing views.
Do check light and dark themes at 1040x680, 1440x900, and 2000x1000.
donts: Don't introduce a new palette, font system, decorative assets, emoji, or glyph icons.
Don't depend on a rich headline, model label, timestamp, or valid Markdown for readable identity and content.
Don't replace useful wide-pane context with longer prose or a full-width reply action.
Don't give routine turn notices separate transcript rows or duplicate the daemon's cost text.
Don't make an observed model label look editable.
